name: quax_hollow_sapphire_2004
title: QUAX hollow-sapphire (two-shell) prototype, pseudo-TM030 at 10.915 GHz

citations.authors_short: D. Alesini, C. Braggio, G. Carugno et al. (QUAX)
items_used: text pp.5-9 (eps, tan_delta, R_s, PMC sector, R_CV)

software.solver_type: eigenmode on a small azimuthal sector with perfect-magnetic (PMC) side walls (exploits m=0 symmetry); S21 driven run for Fig. 6
software.boundary: copper surface resistance R_s = 5.5 mOhm (anomalous regime); sapphire tan_delta

geometry.description: Copper cylinder R_cav=29, h_cav=180 with two coaxial sapphire shells spanning the full height (in the fabricated cavity the shells also penetrate ~10 mm into 11 mm-deep end-plate grooves: <0.1 permil on f and <1% on Q per Fig. 7), conical recess in each end plate with a coaxial antenna at the apex. R_cyl_i are INNER radii of the shells (Fig. 4 sketch arrows end on the inner faces); t_cyl_i are wall thicknesses.

R_cyl_1.note: inner radius of inner shell; measured tube: ID 21.36(10) -> 10.68

R_cyl_2.note: inner radius of outer shell; measured ID 39.71(4) -> 19.855

t_cyl_2.note: measured OD 42.80(1) -> t = 1.545; eccentricity up to 0.2 mm

cone_base_diameter.source: Fig. 10 dimension '20.7' (spans the cone base symmetric about the axis, checked against the 29 mm scale: 186 px vs 188 px expected)
cone_base_diameter.note: Fig. 4 sketch shows base ~ R_cyl_1 (10.7 mm radius); drawing gives 10.35 mm radius

antenna_bore_diameter.source: inferred: scaled from Fig. 10 (36 px at 9.07 px/mm)

end_plate_grooves.value: 11 deep, 2.3 wide; 11.5 and 20.8 are groove CENTRELINE radii -> grooves span r = 10.35-12.65 (inner) and 19.65-21.95 (outer); labels 10.35/11.5/19.65/20.8
end_plate_grooves.note: only for the as-built model; design (Fig. 4) has none

sapphire_length.source: text p.9 (two 200 mm tubes) = 180 + 2x10 mm penetration

antenna_geometry.source: NOT GIVEN (coaxial antennas at cone apex)

walls.note: equivalent normal-skin sigma = pi f mu0 / R_s^2 = 1.42e9 S/m at 10.915 GHz

shells.material: sapphire, Rostox-N, c-axis (0001) along the cylinder axis within 1 deg (text p.9)
shells.anisotropy: scalar eps = 11.2 used in the simulation although the paper states c || axis. For the m=0 pseudo-TM030 with full-height shells E is axial, so eps_par is the relevant component; Table 1 also has an eps=9.39 (~eps_perp) variant.

conditions.temperature_K: cryogenic for the design values; measurement 300 K and 5.4 K

conventions.form_factor_definition: C_mnl = (int dV E.B0)^2 / (V B0^2 int dV eps_r |E|^2) (Eq. 2), V = cavity volume
conventions.Q_definition: unloaded Q from eigenmode with R_s walls + tan_delta
conventions.notes: R_CV = (C030 V)_dielectric / (C010 V)_empty cylinder of same length with TM010 at the same frequency. Fig. 3 fields are at the longitudinal centre; normalization arbitrary (E_z(0)=1).

tables.description: sensitivity of Q and f to one parameter at a time; reference Q = 1.91e6, f = 10.915 GHz
split outer/inner shells moved apart by dx (Fig. 8 tuning design; NOTE different cavity design from Fig. 4, dims not given)

rows: R_CV, flat end plates, Fig. 4 shells
R_CV, optimized shells t1=2.2, t2=1.0 mm, flat
H_phi(outer wall) ratio empty-TM030 / with shells
groove penetration effect on f / Q (Fig. 7)

curves.description: E_z(r) of pseudo-TM030 with sapphire shells (solid line), normalized to E_z(0)=1 [V/m as labelled]

digitization.method: raster dark-pixel trace at 600 dpi (embedded bitmap): column + row run centres of the solid line; analytic empty-cavity dotted curve, thick zero line, band edges and annotation masked; axes calibrated on tick marks
digitization.uncertainty_basis: +-3 px at 600 dpi (line width ~4 px, source bitmap ~374 dpi). Gaps where the solid line crosses the dotted analytic curve or the zero line.

curves.description: H_phi(r) of pseudo-TM030 with sapphire shells (solid line), same normalization as top panel

digitization.method: raster dark-pixel trace at 600 dpi (embedded bitmap): column + row run centres of the solid line; analytic empty-cavity dotted curve, thick zero line, band edges and annotation masked; axes calibrated on tick marks
digitization.uncertainty_basis: +-3 px at 600 dpi (line width ~4 px, source bitmap ~374 dpi). Gaps where the solid line crosses the dotted analytic curve or the zero line.

derived_checks.note: computed by us from Table 1 (not printed): 1/Q = A + p_e tan_delta with the two tan_delta rows -> p_e = 0.167, A = 1.84e-7 -> wall-only Q = 5.4e6, G_total = R_s/A = 3.0e4 Ohm; reproduces Q(2e-6) = 1.93e6 vs 1.91e6 printed.
derived_checks.C010V_reference_for_R_CV: WITHDRAWN as a target: C030 = 0.065 is NOT reproducible. Exact z-invariant model with Fig. 4 dims and flat ends: f = 10.883 GHz, C030 = 0.0410, C030 V = 19.5 cm^3 -> R_CV = 0.45 (vs the printed 0.72) with C010 V = 43.2 cm^3 (empty L = 180 mm cylinder with TM010 at 10.915 GHz, R = 10.51 mm). Tab 2 (dx = 0) gives C V = 24.75 cm^3 (R_CV 0.57). The paper's R_CV reference definition is evidently different/unknown; do not benchmark R_CV.

C030_flat_end_crosscheck.note: exact z-invariant layered model, Fig. 4 dims, flat ends, eps 11.2. Use as a 2D cross-check, NOT as a paper value.

derived_checks.wall_Q_note: Cone dominance: with flat ends the end plates carry ~89% of the wall loss and Q_wall = 1.25e6, vs 5.4e6 implied by Tab 1 -> the cones set Q; Q is a cone-sensitive target (cones ARE dimensioned here, so it remains usable, but with the cone geometry as the main systematic).

fig3_band_edges_mm.source: Fig. 3 shaded bands (blue edge lines), digitized
fig3_band_edges_mm.note: thicknesses 2.16 / 0.99 mm match the 'optimized' t1=2.2, t2=1.0 shells, NOT Fig. 4 (1.9 / 1.6) - see inconsistencies. These edges give f = 10.711 GHz in an exact z-invariant model (not 10.9): Fig. 3 is a THIRD geometry (neither Fig. 4 nor the 10.915 GHz reference); shape-only comparison.

gaps.parameter: antenna (coax) geometry at the cone apex
gaps.proposal: close the apex with PEC (or a 4 mm bore, ~20 mm long, below cutoff at 11 GHz: TE11 cutoff of a 4 mm bore is ~44 GHz) - negligible

gaps.parameter: cone base diameter: 20.7 mm (Fig. 10 drawing) vs ~21.4 mm (Fig. 4 sketch, base at R_cyl_1)
geometry of Fig. 3 field plot and of Table 2 tuning design (Fig. 8)
gaps.issue: Fig. 3 shells are 2.16/0.99 mm thick (optimized design), Table 2 design 'different' and undimensioned
gaps.proposal: compare Fig. 3 curves with a run using R1=10.74, t1=2.16, R2=19.95, t2=0.99 (digitized band edges) AND with Fig. 4 dims; Table 2 only qualitatively (3D anyway)

gaps.issue: Fig. 4 table quotes measured-tube dims rounded ('deviate slightly from optimal')
gaps.proposal: use Fig. 4 table for Table 1 reference (that is what HFSS used); as-built (10.68/1.905/19.855/1.545) as a sensitivity run

inconsistencies.description: Fig. 3 shell bands do not match the Fig. 4 dimension table
inconsistencies.proposal: treat Fig. 3 as the optimized-shell field profile (qualitative/shape check)

inconsistencies.description: 'ratio of the two H fields on the outer wall is about 9' vs Fig. 3 (0.73/0.10 ~ 7)
inconsistencies.evidence: text p.5 vs Fig. 3 bottom at r=29 mm
inconsistencies.proposal: report our ratio; tolerance large (normalization of the two curves differs)

inconsistencies.description: Table 2 dx=0 Q (2.01e6) differs from Table 1 reference (1.91e6)
Table 1 eps = 9.39 row (11.15 GHz): exact-model Delta f = +170 MHz vs paper +235 MHz, while all other rows agree within <=2 MHz (R1 -144/-145, t1 -145/-145, R2 -13/-13, t2 -14/-15, eps 11.5 -24/-25)
inconsistencies.evidence: exact z-invariant layered model: the other Table 1 rows agree within 2 MHz
inconsistencies.proposal: possible typo in the eps = 9.39 row; exclude it or use a loose tolerance

solver_class.reason: Everything in Fig. 4 is axisymmetric and the authors themselves used a PMC-walled azimuthal sector (i.e. m=0). Grooves (Fig. 7/10) are axisymmetric too. Split-shell tuning (Table 2, Figs. 8-9) needs 3D. Omitted in 2D: the longitudinal half-shell seam of the copper body and three 1 mm vent holes (p.12) - harmless for TM0n0 (axial wall currents).

priority_reason: Fully dimensioned axisymmetric dielectric-loaded cavity with cones; f, Q and parameter sensitivities tabulated (Table 1); cleanest QUAX 2D benchmark.

readme_row.quantities: f(TM030)=10.915 GHz, f(TM031)=10.975, Q=1.91e6 + Table 1 sensitivities; R_CV; Fig. 3 E_z(r), H_phi(r); Table 2 split-shell tuning (3D)

notes: Withdrawn: the earlier 'H_phi jump at r = 12.9 mm' inconsistency and the 12.7-13.0 mm exclusion. dH_phi/dr ~ eps E_z, so H_phi only kinks at the shell face; an exact model with the band-edge geometry fits the digitized H_phi at rms 0.013 (E_z 0.003) including r = 12.8, 13.1 mm. Use the whole curve.
